metadata.name: Order Rescue — 30-case MVP database model and raw seed
metadata.status: Reconciled synthetic contract; fixture labels FINAL by product review, not live-model acceptance.
metadata.scope: Nine tables; two assessment slots; one immutable final selection. No golden answers or future replies are seeded.

dim_buyer.role: Buyer reference; buyer history is derived, not stored here

dim_product.role: Optional dimension, kept to match approved ERD; unavailable in synthetic source

dim_carrier.role: Optional dimension, kept to match approved ERD; unavailable in synthetic source

dim_date.role: Reference calendar derived from observed event timestamps

fact_order.role: Current and past orders; history is obtained by buyer_id and delivery-event join

fact_delivery_event.role: Carrier/delivery raw observations, including historical attempts and results

order_rescue.role: One rescue case; at most two stored Agent assessments; final is an immutable selection/copy, not a third Agent assessment.

columns.as_of: ISO datetime; current allowed read cutoff
columns.deadline_at: ISO datetime|null; logistics deadline, not reply-wait duration
columns.final_assessment: object|null; exact copy of selected assessment, not a third assessment
columns.final_action_id: string|null; selected policy final_action; FK to dim_action.action_id

final_assessment_source.rule: 1 = initial; 2 = after reply; null before final or for a pre-AI bypass outside this suite.

cross_field_constraints: Persist initial_assessment and initial_policy_output before emitting the first buyer question.
At most one AI_QUESTION per case; question_key in the stored initial assessment is the planned category.
after_reply_assessment/policy may be set only after a matching BUYER_REPLY interaction; never create them for USER_NO_REPLY.
USER_NO_REPLY preserves initial assessment and initial policy history; final policy is ESCALATE_REVIEW. It does not imply refusal.
When final_assessment_source=1, after_reply_assessment and after_reply_policy_output are null in this suite, and final_assessment equals initial_assessment.
When final_assessment_source=2, both after_reply objects exist and final_assessment equals after_reply_assessment.
Final policy copies selected policy except USER_NO_REPLY, which records a distinct ESCALATED/ESCALATE_REVIEW finalization without rewriting initial policy.
Write final selection and selected policy columns atomically; do not overwrite an already COMPLETED case.
A final candidate CLARIFY is an unresolved-information outcome; it must not issue another question or permit retry.
If pre-AI validation blocks outside these 30 fixtures, all Agent assessment fields remain null; policy handoff may still be stored.

fact_rescue_interaction.role: Source messages/context and runtime controls; no contact/call tracking. T0 buyer context is distinct from post-question buyer reply.

columns.interaction_id: string, required; source reference and idempotency key
columns.question_id: string|null; runtime response/control must bind to the pending question
columns.message_text: string|null; USER_NO_REPLY has no buyer message
columns.occurred_at: ISO datetime, required; runtime assigned when an event is released

conditional_constraints: At most one row with interaction_type=AI_QUESTION for each case_id.
At most one response outcome (BUYER_REPLY or USER_NO_REPLY) for the pending question in this two-stage demo.
BUYER_CONTEXT is phase T0 and has question_id=null; do not count it as the reply that triggers assessment 2.
BUYER_REPLY and USER_NO_REPLY bind question_id to the actual existing AI_QUESTION; ignore duplicate event IDs.
USER_NO_REPLY message_text=null and payload.buyer_reply=null; actor is demo_operator, not buyer.

constraints: One order_rescue per unique failed_event_id; seed mode starts from an existing NEW case.
The failed event order_id must match its rescue case order_id.
Only raw sources are seeded. No expected assessment, planned question text, future reply, selected response mode or golden label is seeded.
Store exactly two possible assessment slots; final is a copy of one slot. No decision-log table or arbitrary round loop is required.
Buyer history comes from prior fact_order rows joined to fact_delivery_event; current fixtures intentionally have no historical orders.
Every populated assessment uses the approved seven hypotheses, three confidence levels and eight missing_info codes.
All source_ref references must resolve to a raw source available at that stage; do not use future replies at stage 1.
No production logistics execution, real buyer messaging, refund, address/COD modification or contact logs.

query_recipes.open_case: Read order_rescue by case_id; join fact_order by order_id and fact_delivery_event by failed_event_id; check both refer to the same order.
query_recipes.buyer_history: Read other orders of the same buyer_id, join delivery events and filter event_time <= as_of; [] is valid and matches this suite.
query_recipes.initial_agent_input: Assemble the seven core fields from database rows, excluding all assessment/policy/result fields. Reconstruct operational_context.buyer_messages_t0 from BUYER_CONTEXT T0 interactions when present.
query_recipes.runtime_context: Supply only released RUNTIME interactions for this case in a separate runtime_context envelope; do not overwrite failed_event or put current reply into buyer_history.
query_recipes.source_references: source_ref_index indexes T0 sources. Runtime interaction_id is its own source_ref; register only when the event is actually released.
query_recipes.write_initial: Validate the six-field assessment and four-field policy output, persist initial slots, then emit at most one permitted question and WAIT.
query_recipes.write_after_reply: After matching BUYER_REPLY, rebuild input plus released runtime context, run Agent once more and store after_reply slots.
query_recipes.write_no_reply: Record USER_NO_REPLY, leave after-reply slots null, preserve initial slots and append a final policy ESCALATE_REVIEW without inference.
query_recipes.final_write: Atomically select final assessment and policy, applying the no-reply policy override; complete and preserve prior audit records.
query_recipes.evaluate: Only isolated test runner reads the paired test file expected data. Agent/tools have database input views only.

source_ref.description: Reference to a source known at this assessment stage.

fact.description: Sourced observation; distinguish reported claims from confirmed facts.

confidence.description: Strength of support for the hypothesis, not delivery-success probability.

missing_info.description: [] means nothing remains missing; a null assessment means no assessment exists.

question_key.description: Planned category at stage 1; category of the question already asked at stage 2/final. Does not authorize a second question.

oneOf.description: No reply deadline or fixed duration. NO_REPLY is a manual demo control, not a buyer statement.

source_ref.description: Reference to a source known at this assessment stage.

fact.description: Sourced observation; distinguish reported claims from confirmed facts.

retry_requires: Direct current buyer intent to receive
COD readiness when payment is relevant
safety: High confidence does not override policy
No real dispatch/return/refund or address/COD change
demo_policy_profile.clarify_when_final: Assessment 1 may retain CLARIFY as immutable history; no-reply final policy escalates to Ops without a second question or inference.

agent_input_envelope.runtime_context: Only released runtime interactions; empty at stage 1

write: question status NO_REPLY; after_reply slots stay null

runtime_contract.time: All current seed cases are evaluated as of 2026-10-24T15:00:00+07:00 and have a synthetic logistics deadline 2026-10-28T15:00:00+07:00. No fixed reply duration; manual no-reply does not simulate clock expiry.
runtime_contract.database_isolation: Reset/clone this seed per test run. Agent reads an explicit raw-input projection, never complete order_rescue rows containing prior outputs.
runtime_contract.atomicity: Question emission is idempotent; reply/skip transition is serialized per case. Final selection is immutable.

dim_action.description: Ask one buyer question if policy permits
Hold for verified disruption and a reassessment point
Handoff to Operations for authorized review
No further action at the current evaluation point

seed_notes: All initial/after-reply/final assessment and policy/result slots start null in all 30 cases.
T0 BUYER_CONTEXT messages for three cases are real raw synthetic input from the workbook, not future replies. Their presence supports HIGH initial confidence when the cause is directly confirmed.
The three T0 buyer messages are stored once as interactions. Retrieval projects them into operational_context.buyer_messages_t0 to reproduce workbook input J.
There are no seeded AI_QUESTION, BUYER_REPLY or USER_NO_REPLY records. Simulator controls and future reply text exist only in the paired test file.
No historical orders are invented: buyer_history=[] in this suite. Schema and query recipe still support history from earlier orders/events.
dim_product and dim_carrier remain empty; optional IDs and unavailable buyer attributes stay null. Do not fabricate order_created_at, COD amount or product/carrier data.
Source references address raw observations. Runtime interaction IDs become source refs only when those records are released and stored.
No new decision-log table is added. Initial and after-reply assessments are two fixed slots; final is a selected copy.
